messages.subject: Cancel Button?
parts:
Hello shiny people.

Let's say I have something like this example https://gist.github.com/wch/4963887

And let's say instead of making a histogram I'm doing some time consuming calculation.  Is there any way to cancel or restart the reactive function while it's in progress?  As it stands now, it actually queues up and calls the function once for each time the actionButton is clicked.

Thanks

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Cancel Button?
parts:
I doubt it. You could try adding a 'cancel' action button and an observer with a high priority (see link below). Not sure what you would have to put in the observer to stop the other reactive(s) however. I doubt 'stop()' would do it. Perhaps if there was an updateActionButton function but there doesn't seem to be (see 2nd link below).

http://www.inside-r.org/packages/cran/shiny/docs/observe
